directives.text: Enforce a chart-level quality gate: any support/resistance shown in caption or chart must have at least 3 touches in the chosen lookback, otherwise omit the level or label it as a trendline; caption must read values directly from the chart object.

Ban ungrounded numeric metrics: no number may appear in a caption unless it exists in the supplied data payload; if derived (e.g., expected move), label it explicitly as ATR-based and show the calculation.

Add a scheduling/selection rule: never post more than 2 consecutive same-category items in one drop; when 3+ same-category posts are queued, merge them into a comparative or sector read instead of repeating the same template.

Keep punchy hooks but hedge all projections and valuation claims: attribute forward-looking numbers to sources and use conditional language like 'if growth holds' or 'suggests' instead of asserting facts like 'set to hit $1T' or 'underpriced growth'.
Require every post to end with a clear 🎯 Verdict line that matches the hook and the stated risk/reward; remove 'Setup: N/A' padding and never leave the verdict missing.

Cap caption length at 3000 characters and cut hidden_value posts to 3 names max, each with a verifiable thesis/catalyst/risk; replace 'nobody's watching' with 'under-covered' and label speculative names like QUBT as speculative.
